title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A classic Uruguayan dish featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of chimichurri sauce for a flavorful and tender meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add beef cubes to the marinade and coat evenly.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Serve hot with chimichurri sauce, crusty bread, and a sprinkle of parsley.
